gemini.title: Boundary Census Scotland Ethnicity Identity Language Religionoa
gemini.abstract: Boundary Census Scotland Ethnicity Identity Language Religionoa is an authoritative dataset published by National Records of Scotland. It represents boundary census scotland ethnicity identity language religionoa features using geometry geometry.
gemini.lineage: Published by National Records of Scotland as open statistics and boundary data. Loaded into Systra PostGIS database without transformation.
